svg.title: Three stationary words at three finite depths
svg.desc: Each row repeatedly chooses one fixed base piece, producing its depth-one, depth-two and depth-three approximations in square coordinates. These nine portraits are selected members of different arrays, not one tiling line. Fine detail is exact and remains visible on zooming the SVG.

g.text: Repeat a piece: a self-similar portrait emerges
Read across a row. The address is (i,j), then (i,j)(i,j), then (i,j)(i,j)(i,j).
These are finite, positive-area approximations. Their infinite attractors have zero area. These selected limits do not tile the square.
